data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order: open Flights, enter origin and destination, pick dates, set passengers, search, then sort/filter. It is slightly off because it assumes round-trip, lumps the dates into one "dates" parameter instead of separate depart and return dates, and leaves out trip type and a filter parameter, but a automation could still be built from it.
